**HUCKABEE SANDERS**
---
ForHUCK PAC for America
---
|
---
| | Dear Friend,President Trump is making the bold choices needed to upend a system that put America dead last for decades. That’s why the radical Democrats view him and his supporters – you and me – as a threat. They are rooting for his presidency to fail and America along with it. You see, the dividing line in America is no longer between _right_ or _left_. It’s between _normal_ and __crazy__. How else can you explain radical Democrats who...
---
* **_Root for the economy to dip. Cheer when egg prices go up. Scoff at border security. And high-five when foreign leaders insult America._**
* **_Fight tooth and nail to halt deportations and bring planes of violent criminal illegals back into our country. Sue to let non-citizens vote.__ _**
* **_Rage against DOGE and Elon Musk.__ _**
* **_Defiantly allow men to invade women’s sports and locker-rooms._**

---
My friend, I’ve got bad news for you. The Democrats are doubling down on their dangerous ideology. And if you and I don’t take immediate action they will claw back power in the upcoming elections and they will use this power to stop President Trump and our America First movement once and for all.So, I need you to ask yourself this question... Is it worth it? Is it worth it to secure the border? Is it worth it to stand up to China? Is it worth it to bring jobs back to America’s heartland? Is it worth it to restore our military? Is it worth it to fix broken schools?**Is it worth it to hold the line? **
---
[ **HOLD THE LINE EMERGENCY REPLY** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a43f5c0dc99c4992b870637c3e9ffac4&_e=Pf07hVvit8INscJdlsv1ybCJLfrE64dtD4uFdf4Ks8_d9M0qGH3HvpccPaPGMjh5g3ZgWdKHLtXMaZ8z-qtegdTIRUccNYHvHZOqek7JQGMcqbuUocOcPk0G_XUbEmDHJQshQL7tZYcYctXrOXZzj60Af2qnV0q26aen9dPa181eyfBdrctz8rT_hnPlrdiBy8QLGgjMXySmSwEkORop0b-j1HQD9ETDsEuQjf-dqBAU305RMA21R843rxJr1iM_WvtxfVhPE9bY2ARWGC1t-r2P9eNKAQCxJPq-IyxGSGBh7x_AiJLrGINfKlm9W5AdpjWC-_lZXUPX3EURZe2J3EeVULEyMGRIuFQLc14t9p9r4I6-tWFBDRhi_n1_r_yLXpr-R-0plFB3oB2Ho0yoCg%3D%3D)
---
Your reputation as an unwavering member of our America First movement gives me no hesitation how you would answer. In fact, that is the reason for my letter. See, I am writing to you today on behalf of Huck PAC for America.My father started Huck PAC for America and built it into one of the most powerful PACs in America when it comes electing conservatives at every level of government. As you may know, my father recently became President Donald J. Trump’s ambassador to America’s most cherished ally – the state of Israel. In accepting this position, my father was required to step away from Huck PAC for America’s helm for a time. Knowing how Democrats would love nothing more than to see one of the most proven and effective forces in American politics sidelined in the upcoming elections, I immediately offered to step in to help.It’s my prayer today that you will do the same.
---
https://politics.raisethemoney.com/en/vikow8gszsvsv9jfq7zd3g
---
I won’t sugarcoat this._Recently, Republicans have lost special elections all across the country, even in in red districts that President Trump carried handily in Iowa and Pennsylvania._ And the Democrats’ Act-Blue “machine’ is raking in millions each day.If you and I don’t move quickly, the radical Democrats _will_ claw their way back into power. I know I don’t have to tell you what this means... impeachment, investigations, lawfare, subpoenas.This is something I witnessed firsthand. As you may recall, for two years I stood at the podium as press secretary during President Trump’s first term. You know, there is a custom that a “flak jacket” (a bulletproof vest) hangs in the White House press secretary’s closet. The pockets are filled with notes from previous press secretaries who’ve shared the experience of squaring off against the media day in and day out. During my two years at the podium, I gained crystal clear confirmation that our country no longer has an objective media to fulfill its First Amendment duty. Nope. So much of the media is filled with liberals who use their platform to come after us. The same way they came after President Trump. The pain is the point:**_A Hollywood actor publicly encouraged people to kidnap my children._****_I was kicked out of a restaurant because I worked for President Trump._****_Members of Congress called for harassment to make those of us working in the Trump Administration afraid to show our face in public._** They are ruthless.And I’ve got to tell you. What I experienced then and still experience today is merely a sliver of the hatred directed at President Trump. Whereas I was given a symbolic bulletproof vest, he took an actual bullet from a would-be assassin.
---
[ **HOLD THE LINE EMERGENCY REPLY** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a43f5c0dc99c4992b870637c3e9ffac4&_e=Pf07hVvit8INscJdlsv1ybCJLfrE64dtD4uFdf4Ks8_d9M0qGH3HvpccPaPGMjh5g3ZgWdKHLtXMaZ8z-qtegdTIRUccNYHvHZOqek7JQGMT7v8yEj9rfwG6if4bjIApVh56HEJhvaGYhmh_DMRkmkCQ__ww8wDHRJ6k5R2t82LeVcZTh-0idsg2vDqZ98VMfmHv6quigsh4yEoxD7D69BdrCbvrEXLnnzYBZbv-Ulp-YmX4f8DCztFSEjWiIgN2vGcMn4SndKxlK_TkLAtqlLZNMJ9a9SmYxVgLNzyPhkJlCSCXJwWhVXGo2MGBfg1VpSB38QuFx0LZsj3fHO5IiozHdkWdLE8SIIWTMa8STv8YVNvWzWb32BnJG_uy0lo2-aIILX-imBonuk3QZOYYPw%3D%3D)
---
But enough with the negativity! I think it’s better to shine a light on the good news... When you and I stand strong and stand together, _we win_. President Trump proved this in a big way in 2024. And Huck PAC for America played a major role in the fight:
---
| | ***** 323 candidates endorsed ***** ***** 282 races won ***** ***** $2,007,550 poured into key races that made all the difference*****
---
Today, I’m imploring you to join the work of Huck PAC for America which is already under way for the 2026 election to see Republicans in more governors’ offices and win more seats in the House and Senate.Well, the very best way to make that happen is to give your full support to Huck PAC for America, and to do it right now, today. The clock is already ticking on the next election. And, as I said at the start of my letter, the Democrats have utterly rejected the message sent by voters in the last election and are, instead, embracing “crazy” by doubling down on their radical, unsafe vision for our country.Historically, the party out of power picks up seats in the midterms. This would gut our majorities and turn them into weak, flailing minorities. This would give Democrats the power over President Trump’s agenda.You and I cannot let this happen. **[So, please click here so send your _HOLD THE LINE Emergency Reply_ back to Huck PAC without delay.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a43f5c0dc99c4992b870637c3e9ffac4&_e=Pf07hVvit8INscJdlsv1ybCJLfrE64dtD4uFdf4Ks8_d9M0qGH3HvpccPaPGMjh5g3ZgWdKHLtXMaZ8z-qtegdTIRUccNYHvHZOqek7JQGNfIKA3UXZsoN6mPje_vOz2PsiNAEN4pjYhK1r4g596yCsFEfIg1Q5nZZvjc7O83bZ-Z4q7NfnDyA084HGGYjxJuYJs7rV7EX8pKL5WAeF6uzSWpIGrfA_7tnWrrEFPNrvsQcPQvurUw-6-0-6vOhSf2UkPx1DkPFjnR0M-Bvf0RL2S1vt4VFKmz4B-WWkwVwdcnRiDdrNU-vh-_sKp7NcPUkSnh2QVpmlnE5WXP0B45bSfGSdHKp0qDliN-TnyNXwYonZyGN90UkedWqw4XWnIQsP5LQVlcIJgsEgviyZi-Q%3D%3D)** One last thought. It’s not enough to elect run-of-the-mill Republicans just to keep the House and Senate. Our side needs fighters. Our side needs pro-life champions, stalwarts for the Constitution, and conservatives who understand the stakes and will hold the line. This is what Huck PAC for America is all about. Join us today.With deepest gratitude,

Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders

Mamdani's win is a victory of the many over the money. And America need more of it--everywhere.
Let's not sugarcoat it. This week, the Democratic machine threw everything they had--billionaire endorsements, NYT op-eds, a deluge of corporate cash, and the full weight of washed-up politicians like Andrew Cuomo, Bill Clinton, and Michael Bloomberg--at Zohran Mamdani. And he still won. Big. The party now has a choice to make, and that choice will determine whether it ever has a chance or truly returning to its roots as a party for working people--or whether it completes its transformation into Republican-lite. How do we ensure they make the right decision, and how do we ensure leaders like Zohran Mamdani become the new face of the party going forward?
**Let 's Address This.**

---|---|---
Zohran Mamdani. Credit: New York Magazine
## History In The Making
What we saw last night was nothing short of historic. A 33-year-old immigrant Muslim socialist from Uganda named Zohran Mamdani uprooted one of the most powerful political dynasties in American history. This wasn't just a political upset. This was a generational rebuke. A reckoning with a Democratic Party leadership that has spent the last decade cozying up to hedge fund managers while scolding progressives for daring to demand housing, healthcare, and dignity. Mamdani didn't just win despite the machine--he won because he rejected it. He ran on taxing millionaires 2% more and raising corporate taxes, to pay for a rent freeze, free childcare, and a fare-free bus system. And working-class New Yorkers--Black, brown, and white, Jewish, Muslim, and Christian, everyone--turned out in force to say: yes, we want that future.
## Establishment Dems & Corporate Media United--to Fail Together
Meanwhile, the same Democratic figures who claim Trump is unfit for office because he is a serial sexual abuser, couldn't bring themselves to oppose Andrew Cuomo--a man accused of serial sexual abuse from at least 11 different women. As the detailed 168-page-report by New York Attorney General Leticia James [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/53a15e70-02f0-49bc-9b9d-96ecfc7817d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Cuomo "reached under her blouse and fondled her breast, grabbed her buttocks, engaged in 'intimate hugs,' and asked at work whether she had ever cheated on her husband."
That's not opinion--that's sworn testimony. And its one of many, many horrifying examples of serial abuse. And yet, Ritchie Torres, Kirsten Gillibrand, Michael Bloomberg, and yes--Bill Clinton--all stood by Cuomo. They endorsed him anyway. They knew. And they sent him their time, money, and support anyway. Is it any wonder why the Democratic Party's approval rating remains at an abysmal 26%?
It's because too many people see what the party refuses to admit: that you cannot be the party of #MeToo, racial justice, and working-class power while propping up men like Cuomo, backing police budgets over school budgets, and kneecapping every progressive candidate who dares to run without Wall Street permission slips.
And likewise, we cannot overlook the sinister role corporate media played in the anti-Mamdani mania.
The New York Times, for example, tried to erase Mamdani entirely. They endorsed former hedge fund manager Whitney Tilson--who currently sits at a whopping .8%. Not 8%, but .8%. The Times picked a real winner. And not content with merely endorsing a multi-millionaire who definitely knows what its like for struggling New Yorkers in 2025, the New York Times then explicitly told voters to _not_ rank Mamdani. And in response New Yorkers instead gave the proverbial middle finger to the Times editorial board, and overwhelmingly ranked Mamdani #1 on their ballots.
_Hey! I 'm votin here!_ Is probably what every New Yorker said, I imagine.
But seriously, that resounding rebuke should terrify every consultant and editorial board still clinging to the belief that they have the trust of the people. That rebuke is a reminder that trust in corporate media is dead. And it is dead because corporate media killed it themselves by repeatedly failing to fulfill their promise of holding the powerful accountable.

## Mamdani Shows How Authenticity Is The Best Defense
Every attack on Mamdani failed for one main reason--Mamdani ignored the Establishment Democratic strategy to "move to the center," (which keeps shifting right by the way) and instead continued to unapologetically lean into his values of fighting for economic justice. New Yorkers responded by trusting his authenticity and sincerity--even as the attacks increased, even as each attack was progressively worse than the last.
_" He's untrustworthy because he changes his accents."_
Yes, this was an actual attack on Zohran Mamdani. Tell me you're white and monolingual without telling me you're white and monolingual. Apparently, those making this attack have never heard of code switching and why Black and brown people regularly engage in such as a humanizing (and survival) method.
_" He's a socialist who wants to take your money."_
New Yorkers voted overwhelmingly for a proposed 2% tax increase on people making $1M or more and a corporate tax rate that matches New Jersey's rate, in exchange for free bus transport, free childcare, and rent freezes.
_" He's antisemitic because he won't visit Israel first as NYC Mayor."_
New Yorkers saw the absurdity of this purity test for a mayor of New York City--which definitely is in the United States last time I checked--and valued his actual answer to serve as a Mayor for all New Yorkers in the five boroughs, period. They saw his alliance with New York City Comptroller Brad Lander, who is proudly Jewish and proudly endorsed Mamdani. They saw Mamdani's efforts to humanize Jews, Muslims, and people of all backgrounds, as who he sincerely is. They saw his plan to increase funding by 800% to combat antisemitic and Islamophobic hate crimes as a meaningful path to peace and reconciliation.
_" He's a scary Muslim and by the way did you know he's brown too?"_
Cuomo's Super PAC literally darkened Mamdani's eyes and grew his beard in their attack ads on him, warning that if you let the scary brown Muslim get elected then...apparently you'll all have to grow beards too? I wasn't sure what the conclusion of that attack ad was--I just know it was dumb, racist, and fortunately didn't work.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b688f303-d77e-418d-94dc-5cb8d4dfe8e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Side by side posted by Zohran Mamdani's campaign comparing Mamdani's actual photo to the one modified by Cuomo's campaign in their attack ad.
Some ads were even more grotesque, like from the New York Times endorsed candidate Whitney Tilson, alleging that Mamdani would engage (somehow) in violence against Jewish people. As a result, Mamdani and his family received death threats, something as predictable as it was inexcusable. Meanwhile, no apologies or retractions from the New York Times on endorsing someone who engaged in such grotesque and dangerous bigotry against a fellow candidate. It's no wonder New Yorkers reject the Times.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/21f40998-4c57-4884-83e3-e41bc3c6f928?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The establishment threw everything they had at Mamdani -- lies, fear, hate, money, influence, and threats. And it all failed because Mamdani has the courage, compassion, coordination, and conviction to lean into who he is unapologetically--a working class immigrant who just wants to ensure his fellow New Yorkers can put food on the table and have a roof over their heads. And New Yorkers responded to his authenticity, proving decisively that the many can win over the money. This is what makes America truly great.
But the question of the hour is this: will Establishment Democrats understand this and get behind Mamdani, or will they continue to run in opposition to him?

## Establishment Democrats Have A Choice to Make
So here we are. Zohran Mamdani is the Democratic nominee for New York City Mayor. Eric Adams has flipped to run as an Independent, clinging to power and Trump-aligned allies like a man with no convictions left--except, of course, the ones the previous DOJ pursued that mysteriously disappeared after a curious backroom deal. Mamdani's campaign showed what happens when you lead with principle and policy--not fear and fundraising.
And so Establishment Democrats must choose. Will you stand with Mamdani and the will of the people, or will you double down as the Republican lite party? How they choose decides the future of this country.
In the coming months, we will see increasing attacks on Mamdani from the center and from the right. Billionaires will pour millions to ensure Mamdani doesn't win. The elite and corporations will oppose him. Mamdani will face racist attacks, Islamophobic attacks, anti-immigrant attacks, and they will threaten his family. Will the Democratic Party give him the platform and resources to stave off these attacks and win in November, or will they be silent and/or complicit? I don't have the answer to that right now. It is a shame that we cannot know for sure whether Establishment Dems will show up for Mamdani, or against.
But one thing is for sure. Mamdani's win is proof positive that running an authentic campaign ferociously focused on the needs of working people is a winning strategy, and it only works if words match actions--which they do for Mamdani. His decisive win is also a warning shot to every establishment Democrat still asking why voters stayed home in 2024? You want turnout? Back the candidates who _actually_ bring people out--candidates who fight for housing, wages, childcare, public transit, and dignity. Early turnout was nearly double in this election over the past NYC primary, and nearly a quarter of voters were new, first time voters. And they turned out for Mamdani.
Meanwhile, the base the Democratic Party claims to champion--Black people, Latinos, Asians, all working-class people, immigrants, and the youth--have made it clear: it's not that we don't care about democracy, it's just that many are not willing to continue to show up for an Establishment Party that doesn't show up for us. (Though for the record, Black women did show up 92% in the 2024 election and that leadership cannot ever be ignored).
Establishment Democrats have a choice, and if they care about our Republic, then they need to choose who their base wants--leaders like Mamdani who put people and principles over politics and propaganda.
## Closing Thoughts
Mamdani's win is not the end. It is the opening salvo of a new Democratic movement--if the party wants it to be. A renewed party that reflects the moral clarity and economic justice our moment demands. One that truly fights for working people in word and in deed, not just in theory. The Democratic Party can learn from this historic win as a blueprint to revive our Republic and deliver a meaningful blow to the destructive ideology of Trumpism. Or, they can continue to write very strongly worded letters that end up in a shredder faster than you can say Mississippi Masala.
Frank Sinatra famously implored about New York--_" If I can make it there, I can make it anywhere_." By no accident, Zohran Mamdani--a working class south Asian immigrant from Uganda, a socialist, and an American Muslim--is the intersection of just about every core base of the Democratic Party. He is the future of this party, and he's proving it by making it in New York. Let's hope the Democratic Party understands this winning strategy, and applies it nationwide. The future of our Republic depends on it.

### TOMORROW: Join Our Telephone Town Hall
**Tomorrow, Thursday, June 26th at 5:30 pm,** Senator Angela Alsobrooks and I are hosting a Telephone Town Hall to answer your questions and provide an update on Donald Trump and the Republicans' bill to gut Medicaid, the Affordable Care Act, and SNAP in order to pay for billionaire tax giveaways. To join our call, you can sign up to be dialed in [**here**](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15699.49892839.7285696.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2foutreach.senate.gov%2fiqextranet%2fEForm.aspx%3f__cid%3dSenVanHollen%26__fid%3d100096&redir_log=076749218573570)**.** By signing up, you will receive a phone call to join our Telephone Town Hall at approximately 5:30 tomorrow evening. The deadline to sign up to receive this call is **Thursday afternoon at 2:00 PM.** If you'd like to listen in but not join the call via phone--or if you miss the sign-up deadline--you can also join our livestream of the town hall on my website **[here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15699.49892839.7285696.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2flive&redir_log=942008812194262)**.

The Trump/Republican plan, currently moving through the Senate, would strip health insurance from 16 million Americans, including 229,000 Marylanders, make groceries and electricity bills more expensive for working families, and blow up our national debt. Why? To pay for tax giveaways for the richest of the rich.

Senator Alsobrooks and I will give everything we have to stop this bill from passing.

We hope you can tune in tomorrow evening as we take your questions and provide answers on how we're fighting back during this unprecedented and challenging time. Chris Van Hollen

Friend — Congratulations to Zohran Mamdani!
This is a huge win for our movement and for anyone who believes in a future where all of us can thrive. A future where everyone has the housing, healthcare, education, and affordable life they deserve.
As a progressive, a Muslim, and an immigrant, I share a lot with Zohran. I faced the same challenges he faced when running for office — hatred, prejudice, threats and more. We’ve both been discounted by the establishment, targeted by billionaire-funded attack ads, and had our ideas dismissed because we dared to dream big and challenge the status quo.
But Zohran said it best in his remarks last night: “Dreaming demands solidarity—but above all dreaming demands work.”
Zohran’s performance is proof that anyone can stand up for progressive values and win if they have the support of a true grassroots movement and a positive message that regular people can get behind.
That’s how we’ve won reelection not once, not twice, but three times here in Minneapolis.

AIPAC has already made it clear that they are looking into my race. If they decide to back a challenger, we will be in for the fight of our lives. They could be prepared, along with other mega-donors, to spend millions of dollars to defeat me.

# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=222%2E1086043%2EQc1Ov9)
Hi Peter, it’s Wes Moore.
I’m going to ask you to **[make an online contribution to our reelection effort.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250625-1?refcode=em-20250625-1&refcode2=222_1086043_Qc1Ov9&akid=222%2E1086043%2EQc1Ov9)** Please, let me explain:
In just five days, we have our first end-of-quarter deadline since Maryland’s fundraising freeze ended. For months, my team was prohibited under Maryland law from any and all fundraising.
**That means we’ve got ground to make up, and we’re starting from behind.** As we get closer to the heat of the re-election fight, we have to hit each and every deadline to keep our momentum going. It’s a BIG obstacle — but it’s one this team has met before and can meet right now.

June 25, 2025
Last year, I helped my good friend and fellow ophthalmologist Mike Goldstein in his race against Congressman Jim Himes in Fairfield County, Connecticut. We knew he had little chance, but someone had to fight, and Mike did.

Himes knew this too. He did not bother to campaign and ran few ads. His war chest of $2 million eclipsed our paltry $40,000 but several orders of magnitude. I called Himes's office so many times to arrange a debate that they blocked my number. But eventually Himes consented in the final week of the campaign.
I expected Congressman Himes to be gracious. Afterall, this Harvard graduate and Rhodes scholar with movie star looks had little reason to dislike Goldstein who is unfailingly polite and was not a threat.

And I was dead wrong.
Himes attacked Goldstein like a rabid dog, calling him a MAGA Republican and castigating him for some bureaucratic glitch on esoteric environmental laws regarding the construction of his swimming pool. He even accused Mike of hiring illegal immigrants - a complete fabrication.
But why?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/645a3266-1aa4-4af6-9136-34d88c3094c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
NYC Mayoral Democratic Primary Winner Zohran Kwame Mamdani
Because Congressman Himes knew something we didn't. He knew Trump was probably going to win because he had access to accurate internal polling, unlike the mendacious push polls - such as the Quinnipiac poll - that overstate Democratic support, with the hope of discouraging Republican turnout.
He also knew what would happen if Trump won. He along with his fellow mainstream Democrats, such as Senator Murphy, would be reduced to insignificance and forced to make endless videos with the hope one or two would become viral. He knew the mainstream press was dead. He knew no one cares anymore about what the New York Times thinks. And most important - he knew that the liberal base of the Democratic Party would be calling for his head.

Afterall, it is moderate Democrats like Jim Himes who tell the liberals that they are unelectable. Who rigged the primary rules to destroy Bernie Sanders in favor of Hillary Clinton and Joe Biden. Who nominated Kamala Harris without a single Democrat voting for her.
The Democrats even ejected their vice chair David Hogg in a backroom deal after Hogg won his position fair-and-square.

And what was David Hogg's crime? He said is was time to get rid of the tired old fogies in the Democratic Party - the fogies who pushed the feckless Biden, the loser Harris and the perpetual Nancy Pelosi.

Congressman Himes may like to attend the No Kings rally attacking Donald Trump, but when it comes to behaving like real kings, you can't beat Democratic Party insiders.

Which brings us to Zohran Mamdani who just won the Democratic primary in New York City, making him the favorite to be the next mayor.

While he is claiming to be a socialist, he is really a communist. He wants to [establish government food stores](https://substack.com/redirect/0bea5756-eca8-42f1-8da5-9791e4e93537?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) supposedly to stop the greedy capitalists from exploiting the masses. Never mind that every time this has been tried in the past - it results in long lines for stale bread. He wants to globalize the intifada, the movement to abolish Israel. He wants to impose massive rent control which will result in uninhabitable housing as it has so many times in the past. He wants to replace the police with social workers.
Mamdani's father is a Marxist professor and Mamdani' middle name is Kwame, after the Marxist Ghanan president, [Kwame Nkrumah,](https://substack.com/redirect/8915edc3-d407-4a26-bfdc-e91f414f1e92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) whose Communist polices decimated this once prosperous country in the 1960s.
Mamdani was even too much for the liberal New York Times, who led a campaign against him and [even stated](https://substack.com/redirect/f4a40ee9-8fe1-4bfb-80b6-1501277745e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "We do not believe that Mr. Mamdani deserves a spot on New Yorkers' ballots."

Mamdani's main opponent was the useless Andrew Cuomo, who was booted out of the Governor's mansion after being accused of sexually harassing employees.

Trump's conservative appointees to the Supreme Court have mostly overturned lower court rulings limiting Trump's power while outraging liberals with decisions such as allowing Tennessee to ban gender-affirming treatments.

They have rioted, burned Teslas and screamed at mainstream Democrats behind closed doors. But now they have come up with the most effective weapon - voting.

Stay tuned and get out the popcorn. This is going to be entertaining for all political junkies.

I'm a HELL NO on the Big, Beautiful BETRAYAL, and I hope you'll join me. This is more than an attack on health care. It's an attack on working families, children, seniors, and people with disabilities all across America, including right here in Oregon. The stakes are even higher for rural communities. These devastating cuts could force hundreds of rural hospitals to shut their doors for good. That means longer drives in emergencies, lost jobs, and lives put at risk. Trump calls it "big" and "beautiful." Let's call it what it really is: a betrayal. The Republican plan is simple: families lose, billionaires win. Let's stand together and fight back. | I’ll never stop fighting to create a more accepting and equal country that lives up to the ideals of our nation.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=4778%2E35263%2Ebew4Pn)
Peter, can I tell you a story? When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service, but I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly. [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-jun25.jyIeiz&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20250625_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=4778%2E35263%2Ebew4Pn) After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love, I came to realize that I could do both: **I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly what I did.** When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation’s history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that. But I didn’t run to make history, I ran to make a _difference_. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too. **[I can’t keep up this work without your help. Will you help me continue to make a difference by making a grassroots donation toward our end-of-quarter fundraising goal?](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/4600?c0=stb-em-jun25.TQIaDh&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20250625_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=4778%2E35263%2Ebew4Pn)** | [DONATE](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/4438?c0=stb-em-jun25.BSYi_x&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20250625_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=4778%2E35263%2Ebew4Pn)

With Trump back in the White House, the LGBTQ+ community is facing an onslaught of concerning attacks. To date, this administration has already launched **263 attacks on LGBTQ+ people.**
From pulling over $800 million in research on LGBTQ+ health care, to targeting universities that refuse to discriminate against transgender athletes, to scrubbing mere mentions of the word “gay” from federal websites — these attacks are meant to intimidate a community that’s only asked for true equality.
As this administration pulls every lever to undo the progress we’ve made toward equality, I’ll **never** stop fighting to create a more accepting and equal country that lives up to the ideals of our nation.
It’s going to take all of us to counter these extreme attacks so everyone grows up knowing they belong, and that kindness and inclusion — not hatred and division — are American values.
**[I’m hoping you’ll support this important work by chipping in to my fight for a more equal future, and to help me support democratic candidates who will do the same. body:
Scott Brown just announced his campaign in New Hampshire.
It’s official, Peter:
**Scott Brown just announced he’s running to flip New Hampshire’s Senate seat red.**
If that name sounds familiar, it’s because he’s run for Senate — and lost — before. In Massachusetts. Then he ran here, hoping Granite Staters wouldn’t notice. But we did.
Now he’s back, with support from the national Republican machine, trying to buy his way into the Senate again. It’s up to our grassroots team to stop him.
**[Peter, split a $10 contribution now between my campaign and Heartland Patriots and join the fight to beat Scott Brown.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90139?refcode=em20250625-9046&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9046%2E614464%2E9L6wx-)**
**This is a serious threat.** The GOP sees New Hampshire as one of their best chances to expand their Senate majority — and they’re counting on Scott Brown to help them do it.
_But this seat doesn’t belong to Scott Brown._ It belongs to the people of New Hampshire.
I was born and raised here. I’ve run a family business, represented our communities in Concord and in Congress, and delivered for the people who call this state home — from lowering prescription drug costs to defending reproductive freedom and our democracy.
Scott Brown’s record is clear:
❌ He supports Trump’s MAGA agenda.
❌ He voted to defund Planned Parenthood.
❌ He opposed marriage equality and the Affordable Care Act.
That’s not who we are. And that’s not who should represent us.
This race is now one of the most competitive in the country — and the GOP is ready to pour millions into this race to try to win it and expand the Republican Senate majority.
**But we’ve beaten Scott Brown before. And with your help, we’ll do it again.**

# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=2829%2E400544%2EqwzAyK)
Hi, it’s Dylan. I’m Deb’s campaign manager.
We’re just days away from closing the books on our fundraising for the quarter. What we raise before **midnight on June 30** will shape what this campaign can do in the months ahead.
**Here’s the truth: New Mexico is not a safe blue seat.** For decades, the governorship has flipped parties every 8 years. We’re determined to break that cycle.
**But we’re hearing whispers that a self-funding Trump Republican could jump into this race — someone who could personally bankroll their campaign and outspend us without blinking an eye.**
Deb’s never had personal wealth to fall back on. What we have is this people-powered team — and right now, our fundraising is behind where we need to be. **That’s why we’re setting a big goal to raise $75,000 between now and our deadline on Monday.**
**[We’ve got a lot of ground to make up and just a few days left to do it. If Deb and our campaign can count on you, will you make your most generous donation today to help us reach our end-of-quarter goal? Our last two Senate races went into runoffs and saw MILLIONS of dollars in Republican spending, and both Sen. Ossoff and Sen. Warnock won by razor‐thin margins.

The GOP will spend early, flood Georgia’s airwaves, **and try to push us into the weeds before we even have a chance to respond.**

**BREAKING NEWS:** Zohran Mamdani defied the odds to win the NYC mayoral primary. ** This is a huge victory for regular people and grassroots organizing.**
* Mamdani’s campaign relied almost entirely on small-dollar donations while his main opponent, former Governor Andrew Cuomo (the same Cuomo who resigned as Governor under multiple sexual assault allegations) was backed by the billionaire class.
* Deep pocketed super PACs tried to drown out Mamdani’s campaign with attack ads, but the widespread coalition backing Mamdani fought back at the doors, on the phones, in person and online to set the record straight.
* The opposition were (and frankly are still) afraid of Mamdani’s platform, painting it as radical, but Mamdani set a clear and concise message: New Yorkers should be able to afford to live in New York. body:
Elections are about choices, and next year’s midterms couldn’t be more stark

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110243041/553715819/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzkwMTJkNC1mMjUxLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9_dGls9sPDubBLFtKTcOl-QB_PPJ9KqTbM2g0XZHgbU=) I’m guessing that you got involved in this campaign for the same reason I did: You believe that elections have consequences. Generally speaking, I like to focus on the positives: The rights we can protect, the jobs we can create, the progress we can achieve. body:
Hope is a strange feeling, but a welcome one.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250625-1&t=1&akid=2299%2E587540%2EKbN1Ka)
Last night, Zohran Mamdani broke the bounds of what the world thought was possible.
**Zohran Mamdani achieved a historic victory in the Democratic primary for mayor of the biggest city in America — and your support helped make it happen.[If you’re ready to elect more young progressives, please donate to Leaders We Deserve right now. Then I hope you’ll read the rest of this email.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250625_1_zohran?refcode=em20250625-2299&amount=5&refcode2=2299_587540_KbN1Ka&akid=2299%2E587540%2EKbN1Ka)**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250625_1_zohran?refcode=em20250625-2299&amount=5&refcode2=2299_587540_KbN1Ka&akid=2299%2E587540%2EKbN1Ka)
We didn’t just beat Andrew Cuomo last night. We beat $30 million in spending by the same billionaires who backed Donald Trump AND a political and media establishment that told us this race was unwinnable. Zohran ran on a bold, progressive vision, and proved that young, people-powered candidates can WIN, even in the biggest city in the country.
Leaders We Deserve was the single largest outside spender for the campaign, investing $300,000 in a Zohran affiliated SuperPAC. But more than that, we hit the streets. I was in NYC alongside Zohran’s team, knocking doors, talking to volunteers, and watching this remarkable movement cross the finish line.
I got to see firsthand the relentless positivity that Zohran brought to this campaign. People believed in this movement. They showed up. Every time I passed someone on the street with a Zohran sticker, it turned out to be another volunteer. This campaign was not just impactful, but was JOYFUL. It won not because it had Republican billionaires on its side. Zohran won because he had tens of thousands of volunteers on his side who all believed he could win even when most counted him out. Those volunteers won this campaign.
Races like this show us what limits us as a country and a party is not how hard we can work or how many doors we can knock, it's how big we can dream so we have a message compelling enough that people will go door knocking in 100 degrees or keep phone banking or working the polls. Thank YOU for helping us take one step closer to making our dream a reality for so many Americans, especially young Americans looking at this race for any reason to hope and not give up.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250625_1_zohran?refcode=em20250625-2299&amount=5&refcode2=2299_587540_KbN1Ka&akid=2299%2E587540%2EKbN1Ka)
**This is what happens when you give young people a candidate to believe in, and it’s why we’re not stopping here. This win is a symbol of Democratic voters’ deep desire to turn the page on a failed status quo and the leaders who created it.**
We launched Leaders We Deserve because we were tired of being told to wait our turn. Last night proved we don’t have to. We can run now. We can win NOW.
Our mission is simple: help young, bold leaders win power and transform what’s possible in American politics to combat the hopelessness so many have that represents the greatest threat to Democracy. The establishment has never been weaker than they are now. Leaders We Deserve has more incredible young candidates running for state and federal office across the country — and with your help, we’re going all-in to help them win.
**[Zohran's victory is just the beginning. Peter, if you're with us, can you chip in $5 to fuel our next wave of wins?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250625_1_zohran?refcode=em20250625-2299&amount=5&refcode2=2299_587540_KbN1Ka&akid=2299%2E587540%2EKbN1Ka)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250625_1_zohran?amount=5&refcode=em20250625-2299&refcode2=2299_587540_KbN1Ka&akid=2299%2E587540%2EKbN1Ka)**
Let’s make this the cycle we change everything.
ALSO: Special shout out to the monthly small dollar donors who came up to me at the election party for Zohran! Without people like you we could not do this work.
In solidarity,
David Hogg
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20250625-1&t=2&refcode2=2299_587540_KbN1Ka&akid=2299%2E587540%2EKbN1Ka)**

subject: There is no true freedom without control over our own bodies

body:
We’ve seen the consequences.
#
Yesterday marked three years since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , ripping away the federal right to abortion.
Since then, MAGA extremists have been working to ban it everywhere, and we’ve seen the consequences.
**Abortion is now banned or severely restricted in more than a dozen states.** Patients are being denied care, forced to cross state lines, or worse. In some states, doctors are being threatened with criminal penalties for providing medical services.
I firmly believe there is no true freedom without control over our own bodies.
That’s why in the State Senate, I worked to make Delaware a safe haven for reproductive care, protecting the right to abortion in the state.
**Now in Congress, I’m keeping up the fight for reproductive freedom for all. But the reality is that with Republicans in control, a nationwide abortion ban remains a threat.**
If we want to protect the right to choose, we have to flip the House next year — and that is going to take all of us working together. So I’m asking:
[**Can you pitch in $5 ahead of our important end-of-quarter deadline next week to help us take back the House majority and continue our work to protect reproductive rights?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250625-1?refcode=em20250625-2125&amount=5&refcode2=2125_21716_orstRn&akid=2125%2E21716%2EorstRn)

Fellow American,

**My name is Scott Brown, and I want to take a few minutes to share my story with you and how the experiences and lessons I’ve learned have led me to make a big decision this week.**

[](http://links.action.supportstevedaines.com/u/click?_t=71faa67ca88f4c4b899697b6a4621901&_m=c6f3bd29de5844bd8add734bb5448b2a&_e=gu-3hnMyqYzrYNAGZDrOHRCp0JwTuL87jZL3umShFbHclKv6WO5NuhhhUp9sul6dSV8j0QyJArqCKd8L1euqXIb1xMAR-5dL-1raSZV77sUZ76pliXe3tMvSQJ9LEhP4XRbJ2BEPtXhnHr2BZBedySyJz3uSZUSLhrzBRGAA44mNP5YyZhu03qabuUSLWX_4KLFIi0PZL0KKUe7A4WT5NFeYZKTU27VMPLt44QuDy-_87wkYYaSULl214oZJeQ4F5jY8NxYCADTjOhg2I3pFt5ErDFKuGmSYeQRiHmUvtfyq0cs5pcaoLer0F-b0-wwVWQ0VGuxsqmp1ke4RTyqy8T44vaDKcF080YohWFenO8L0FWfNAKpyzyj6EWYgDO_-tmx0zl4kY1biFy8KGlP8MmM6hWmpRy8aMAbMJwZ7GixC5de8zhUesVzyCb1HM7BgDQO5ltzVDGbE-qOxBxdi7JA9M4SBhOAKNrXNqvRgRS9pxO3vYknTLSbrPzfVVCYkNcMwHda3wsWMi0foKrNFA4z8svV9FvIUh9eOpNVI4yQsmtDrUpR5K5bL_xqAbTR5BwjNOaXFys9DmZKQs2_-MVQ4gPZOzltfamlHzGFTe8RO5G8HrDeUyAubSzE1CKnCWvLbU9R_x-lRM3KdAJmNAeVwzRJzDaYDP9tgVqo_ewsb5i0F0tt1-VNU3NFWcAIPGaYYiBMVUyCGdhMkzyyLHa8PPnAGmAaw2593yI68vqg%3D)
I had a challenging upbringing. My mom was married and divorced 4 times, and my dad was married and divorced 3 times. I was raised by my single mom, who worked multiple jobs to put food on the table. We didn’t have much, but with the love and support of my grandparents, we had a fighting chance. We moved often - I lived in 17 different places before I turned 18.

[](http://links.action.supportstevedaines.com/u/click?_t=71faa67ca88f4c4b899697b6a4621901&_m=c6f3bd29de5844bd8add734bb5448b2a&_e=gu-3hnMyqYzrYNAGZDrOHRCp0JwTuL87jZL3umShFbHclKv6WO5NuhhhUp9sul6dSV8j0QyJArqCKd8L1euqXIb1xMAR-5dL-1raSZV77sUZ76pliXe3tMvSQJ9LEhP4XRbJ2BEPtXhnHr2BZBedySyJz3uSZUSLhrzBRGAA44mNP5YyZhu03qabuUSLWX_4KLFIi0PZL0KKUe7A4WT5NFeYZKTU27VMPLt44QuDy-_87wkYYaSULl214oZJeQ4FNJ40wZmNtZO59ldSuyZlzp1YPYSriiNn1bRCUjzpFADmuBInuy7VNXFXkrkp6mnKppdghlfeFBJ-aNgogjzDnK9cvKJEWuoAyzFsyFJlJg3Dz5EhnGbcRJEK9JBsURcQG_jgAxxmBuEbZgFurV3a8PXsaS9mddT0RUYsNdaUS5dd-rJtaeKE4MD24lrUBBWx0RL5vIJnYPYCM-ULqndEEb4WC1_tSZIYQtSE6qMNQBTVHh30igUMo4BGr2JTt055u9M9sJKMglBcpIfGxigQ9z2yqrAPuHwBrsg3WDG0TktT3t4NDQXYwhkxMQeLM8vXHyN4RFwTPNA9dxtVXEowHMY20AuNHZ49vShcaMEXdY4Ea9dqGIZ0ejjTINu0uW0-h4RQzq929NcnXrWYQYZor5MVwyeBv-5KG42WRywmKIulvFrdWKavjcaBBjRPrJiQdFxyBaiUE_xz-ZogrVZjX9F1G5WXtT4_F_CX-d6VcfY%3D)
I know what it’s like to worry about where your next meal is coming from or whether the bills all get paid. _And those early years taught me the value of grit, of resilience, and hard work_.

**Nothing in my life has ever been handed to me -- I’ve had to fight for every step forward.**

I'm Josh Williams - my father died when I was 5, I was raised by a single mom, and I was homeless at 18 and forced to sleep on park benches. At 21, I fell thirty feet working at the railroad and shattered my spine into a million pieces. I was bedridden and barely able to move. At my heaviest, I weighed over 450 pounds. I remember asking God, "Why me?" I could have accepted my fate, cursed God, and lived off a government check all the way to an early grave. Instead, I said, "Why not me?" I spent the next 6 grueling years on the long road to recovery. I lost over 250 pounds, endured 42 procedures on my spine, 5 major back surgeries, started college at 30, finished law school in Toledo, and clawed my way up from rock bottom. [https://fox59.com/indianapolitics/braun-celebrates-indiana-health-care-reform-at-ceremonial-bill-signing/](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/vbTL00fi9YCxIgUeq2siwaUFGumLV0Ww1wJiqndSEP0cJjbXZUlB6sA30KrFZF-q35_iw17143WiwPvMs-vLfDH41Cdzx8RTyEOh9cB3mBCVOqdRK_P_dlLXgisi_dGoQEn1I-5uxxdV74G2qi_Rc0iDRPOis9haAPlSfNqmY6IWFei8dcLq8H9nPQtWX9ku7-aPFC1rw2VriGk9UC8hk4fP9js8eBMc_FZuz3xcyrA6zRq0E2oDPSCQMmHjXHlXa1KUvrWmFIrVBKnt0U9BxqOQmx6SjOlotFpk9yr5Oj5jiDVE_itiJfjA54B696VVkW8RYM18XooMA8LgGWo3GOoOFZT7pEl18xKM5MQtLhs886wuw1nliIEX3aBLoIed8Kjmr9xxGIoIHmFjGLVu87IwEPVTU8HuY2RsgFA0S8PB-nPJtRKA_02OOoVmqpzZul4Q2j-lhOCvywwUJ-y5-qd40pTgklJCb_6Z_wTQeHavPcBmMm_h6lb-stHNhU4BAGJHUUN0yIi-3Ppm61xcsc8oiqdrssqNZ_lCLoNZN7a0tNrW4m2kFUPRRvk8ZpY/DajR3l8I4Opjy3vC2XMoB2R94RgeVluz/10) At a ceremonial bill signing on Wednesday, Indiana Gov. Mike Braun announced that the state of Indiana is “leading the nation in health care reform.”

Braun ceremoniously signed 10 bills into law on Wednesday, laws that Braun believes will “bring substantial reform to health care in Indiana” through the following solutions:
* Lowering prices
* Health care price transparency
* Eliminating anti-competitive practices

This is something that Braun spoke about at length about these goals during his campaign and during his State of the State address. According to previous reports, Braun said some healthcare-related topics were seen as “too tough to tackle.”

“I promised Hoosiers I would take on the big health care industry and get solutions to the problems making health care unaffordable,” Braun said in a news release surrounding the ceremonial bill signing. “My partners in the General Assembly and I have enacted landmark health care solutions to bring transparency, accountability, and competition to our health care system. Indiana is now the national leader in health care reform and lowering prices for patients.” Several bills were celebrated on Wednesday, according to the release, including: **House Bill 1003: Health matters** The release said that this was a “priority agenda” bill this session, a bill that incorporated “a number of provisions intended to bring transparency, accountability and enforcement mechanisms to the health care industry.”
The bill included the following measures:
* Empowers Hoosiers with rare and terminal diseases by expanding the state’s right to try statute to include individualized treatments.
* Codified federal protections against surprise medical bills
* Clarified that patients and employers have an absolute right to access their health information and claims data at no cost.

Reduced the turnaround time from five days to 48 hours in which providers and insurers must provide a good faith estimate for a patient’s out-of-pocket costs for in-patient and/or out-patient treatment.
**House Bill 1004: Health care matters** The release said that this legislation introduced additional initiatives, including: Hospital cost transparency.
Requires a nonprofit hospital system to submit audited financial statements. Requires an Indiana nonprofit hospital system’s aggregate average inpatient and outpatient hospital prices to be equal to or less than the statewide average by 2029 Establishes a Medicaid state-directed payment program for hospitals.
**SB 2: Medicaid matters** Officials said this legislation creates “several Medicaid reforms around eligibility, reporting, work requirements and presumptive eligibility.”
**SB 3: Fiduciary duty in health plan administration** This bill requires pharmacy benefit managers and third party administrators “to have a fiduciary duty to the plan sponsor” that the managers and administrators are acting on behalf on.
**SB 140: Pharmacy benefits** The release said that this bill prohibits pharmacy benefit managers from utilizing “anti-competitive contracting and business practices against pharmacies.”
**SB 118: 340B drug program report** This legislation requires covered entities participating in the 340B Discount Drug Program to annually report certain information and financial transactions to the Indiana Department of Health.
**SB 475: Physician noncompete agreements** This bill prohibits hospitals from requiring a physician to enter a noncompete agreement after July 1.
**HB 1604: Cost sharing; out-of-pocked expense credit** This bill requires health plans to credit the amount paid for a lower-cost, out-of-pocket healthcare service toward an individual’s deductible. This comes regardless of whether or not the service was provided by an in-network or out-of-network provider.
**HB 1666: Ownership of healthcare providers** The release said this bill requires hospitals, insurers, pharmacy benefit managers, third party administrators and entities that accept Medicaid and Medicare to report ownership information to the state.
**SB 480: Prior authorization** The release said this legislation “revises Indiana’s prior authorization regulatory framework to better protect the provider-patient treatment plan and timely access to care.”
[To Read The Full Story Click Here](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/6SN2r2dEZTkwfgaH9jUHc2Xh9kGPZTB6ULY1_tvf-m72vU3jrMTOGCWGrxaKTzal5gdV1ysID129yBkK8oDGGzveFeafmZmME1ofEGCLlfgvMhM96rAF9YKETiNzeav9FtVF3GkKFgHpZteAGfgEKAM3BINGyGw74zgFL-uEfS23h_2N5ckaK_h0Fl4ilFV7HF4H9-QBOHFfJHbGENmM12f4OEisWPe8ysiQrJV4i5RnjRzUTnYQowR49ADiM9AqJn_L6_5gHNSfl5YLl5AvDCmsFiVmfD4FbXhEQMmNenqWk1RuxmLUxtFoT3OF-iG0_Fbbkpilwnn06A8oN7OpEJ__Oco0PJDOwlOm7yLin2bmeW9nOs8uy-a5iuSI_3LqQ1pRHWDzQDVQiejXWREA1GZBrl8ZgarMQoumxkFiZr6LY3bAe8om2r8fMs0YFHIW0a9CmpqWNReCXIq7VxIwFV16e_OyEGnpP7eupX_ZhXdaQ8L1DWymHzhmGpmtH8azglEfVCjr9h31pmlLX0odVY82JtDQdrTLF9Vmn5DJge_NmYw5xR7Bqurfu4mDM48/UNJF16WUEQUDpLXVOjXrdoFuq3YamqaY/10)

Happy Pride month,
Peter! 🏳️🌈🏳️⚧️

Across the world, people are coming together to celebrate LGBTQ+
visibility.

At a time when federal nondiscrimination protections, gender-affirming
care, and so much more are at risk, it is more important than ever to
unapologetically show up and celebrate queer joy.

Remember, Peter:
Pride began as a protest. In the 60s and 70s, police would routinely raid
queer gathering spaces. What became known as the Stonewall uprising and
the foundation of Pride month was initially a protest in response to
police raiding a queer bar on June 28, 1969. The very first Pride marches
took place the next year to commemorate the resilience and unapologetic
joy of the LGBTQ+ community.

The Squad will always defend the rights of LGBTQ+ people to show up in the
world exactly as they are.

Business leaders and policymakers have been sounding the alarm for years: The employer-sponsored health insurance model is unsustainable. But with the cost of group health insurance premiums up 25% in five years, a fix may be in the works.

Introduced during the first Trump administration, individual coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangements continued to receive federal support through the Biden years. Now, if key provisions under consideration in the “One Big Beautiful Bill” are passed, Congress will expand ICHRAs (renaming them “CHOICE” arrangements) and transform them into a compelling alternative to traditional group health insurance.

Just as we saw a transition away from employer pension plans to 401(k) plans for retirement, many believe we’re starting to see a comparable shift in the way health benefits work. As an alternative to the costly group health insurance model, ICHRA allows companies to make tax-preferred contributions toward the premiums of health plans employees select for themselves and their families in the open market. Fellow Conservative,

My name is Adam Schwarze, and if this is your first time hearing from me, let me introduce myself.

I was born in St. Paul, Minnesota, in 1983 and adopted by Joel and Deb Schwarze when I was six months old. I grew up in Bloomington, where hockey was more than a pastime—it was a foundation for leadership and teamwork.

After the terrorist attacks on 9/11, I felt a deep calling to serve. **On my 18th birthday in October 2001, I enlisted as an infantryman in the United States Marine Corps. I deployed with the 1st Marine Division during Operation Iraqi Freedom, earning multiple valor and meritorious promotions awards.**

In 2013, I achieved my lifelong ambition by becoming a **Navy SEAL Officer, serving with SEAL Team Three and later joining the elite undersea-focused enterprise of U.S. Special Operations Command.** Over my 21-year military career, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, conducting combat, intelligence, and humanitarian missions.

Now, I'm stepping up to serve Minnesota in a new capacity—as a Republican candidate for U.S. Senate.

**The Stakes in This Race Are Enormous.**

I'm running against **Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor** , who is even more radical than he is. While Minneapolis was burning during the 2020 riots, she wasn't defending the people or supporting the police—she was preparing a lawsuit _**against**_ the Minneapolis Police Department.

Governor Walz wants America to believe **Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents are the Gestapo.** His words, not mine. And this is who they call a “moderate.”

So ask yourself: _**If this is what their moderates sound like, what is their real agenda?**_

**Every time the left doesn't get their way, they call Republicans Nazis.**

Every time we demand border security or want criminal illegal aliens deported, they call us bigots.

But you know better—and so do I. Enforcing immigration law is not hateful.**It's common sense**. It's about **protecting Americans**.

clean_body: As much as Tim Walz would have America believe that Immigration officials are the new Gestapo, it really couldn’t be further from the truth. | Fellow Conservative, My name is Adam Schwarze, and if this is your first time hearing from me, let me introduce myself. I was born in St. Paul, Minnesota, in 1983 and adopted by Joel and Deb Schwarze when I was six months old. I grew up in Bloomington, where hockey was more than a pastime—it was a foundation for leadership and teamwork. After the terrorist attacks on 9/11, I felt a deep calling to serve. On my 18th birthday in October 2001, I enlisted as an infantryman in the United States Marine Corps. I deployed with the 1st Marine Division during Operation Iraqi Freedom, earning multiple valor and meritorious promotions awards. In 2013, I achieved my lifelong ambition by becoming a Navy SEAL Officer, serving with SEAL Team Three and later joining the elite undersea-focused enterprise of U.S. Special Operations Command. Over my 21-year military career, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, conducting combat, intelligence, and humanitarian missions. Now, I'm stepping up to serve Minnesota in a new capacity—as a Republican candidate for U.S. Senate. The Stakes in This Race Are Enormous. I'm running against Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor , who is even more radical than he is. While Minneapolis was burning during the 2020 riots, she wasn't defending the people or supporting the police—she was preparing a lawsuit against the Minneapolis Police Department. Governor Walz wants America to believe Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents are the Gestapo. His words, not mine. And this is who they call a “moderate.” So ask yourself: If this is what their moderates sound like, what is their real agenda? Every time the left doesn't get their way, they call Republicans Nazis. Every time we demand border security or want criminal illegal aliens deported, they call us bigots. But you know better—and so do I. Enforcing immigration law is not hateful.It's common sense. It's about protecting Americans. Fellow Conservative, if you're sick of being called a Nazi because you want a secure border, then Here's What I Believe: I believe that no one is above the law—especially criminal illegal aliens who commit rape, murder, and violence against American citizens. I believe in a strong border, deporting those who break our laws, and respecting the rule of law —no exceptions, no apologies. I believe that veterans, police officers, working families, and law-abiding Americans deserve a voice in the Senate—not professional politicians who mock us and ignore our communities. I've Never Run for Office Before. That's the Point. Unlike my opponent, I wasn't groomed for politics. I joined the military on my 18th birthday—October 2001—just weeks after the attacks on our homeland. I didn't run from duty. I ran toward it. While Tim Walz was dodging deployments, I was deployed nine times. I fought to protect conservative American values—the ones that raised me, the ones that made this country great, and the ones that are now under daily assault. Tim Walz hand-picked my opponent in the U.S. Senate race to be his lieutenant governor. We can’t trust him due to his past actions in the military and the governor's mansion, so it should go without saying that we can’t trust her, either. Fellow Conservative, I'm asking you for something personal today—something I never thought I'd do: Minnesota hasn't gone Republican in a presidential race since 1976. But we're not a deep-blue state. Not yet. With Senator Tina Smith retiring, this is our moment. The seat is open. The field is fluid. And I believe—with everything in me—that if we build now, we can flip this seat, and flip the narrative. I Don't Have the Media. I Don't Have Hollywood. I Don't Have the Swamp. What I have is grit, a record of service , and hopefully, the support of patriots like you who still believe America is worth fighting for. If you're tired of watching cities like Minneapolis fall apart while liberal elites cheer it on... And if you believe we deserve leaders who've fought for this country— Then I'm humbly asking you to join my team today. Let's do this. Let's turn the tide. Let's win. With gratitude, Adam Schwarze Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate - Minnesota FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate Adam Schwarze is a former Navy SEAL and Marine. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Some well-deserved good news,
Peter:

Yesterday, 33-year-old Democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani won the
Democratic primary in New York City’s mayoral race, defeating a disgraced,
corrupt former governor from a famous political dynasty with the backing
of billionaires, corporate Super PACs, career politicians, and the party
establishment.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250625?refcode=em20250625-36789&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36789_1203867_nRQ7BU&akid=36789%2E1203867%2EnRQ7BU ]Screenshot of news search results showing coverage of Zohran Mamdani’s
victory in the New York City mayoral primary. Headlines include: The
Guardian – ‘On to victory’: supporters overjoyed as Zohran Mamdani defeats
Andrew Cuomo in New York primary; Jacobin – In Zohran Mamdani’s Win,
Socialism Beat the Status Quo; CNN – Takeaways from New York City’s
mayoral primary: Mamdani delivers a political earthquake. Thumbnails next
to each headline show images of cheering supporters and Mamdani speaking
at a podium.

Make no mistake: This is a MASSIVE win for our progressive, working-class
movement that dares to put forward a bold vision and fight for the people
instead of the corporate elite.

Zohran campaigned on lowering costs for New Yorkers through free buses, a
rent freeze, no-cost childcare, city-owned grocery stores, taxing
corporations and the 1 percent, raising the minimum wage to $30 by 2030,
and more.

Surprise! That’s what working people want from their leaders.

Not only that, but he notably did not throw marginalized communities like
trans youth, immigrants, or Palestinians under the bus like so many in the
Democratic Party are so quick to do in an attempt to win elections.

Zohran has shown that when you're brave and stand up to a political
establishment that thinks lowering costs for everyday people is too hard
(on their billionaire donors, that is) — you can inspire millions that
another future is possible.

When polls showed Zohran gaining on Andrew Cuomo in the last few weeks,
Cuomo-supporting super PACs fueled by lobby groups, corporations, and
billionaires like Michael Bloomberg and Trump-supporter Bill Ackman dumped
a record-shattering $25 million into the race.

The Democratic establishment claims it's desperate to win back young and
disaffected voters, but every time someone actually inspires people, they
unite CEOs and corporate Super PACs against them because their policies
aren't billionaire-approved.

People are done waiting for political courage. That’s why Zohran — fueled
by grassroots donations and matching public funds — prevailed. This
election was a referendum on the old Democratic Party that refuses to
change and separate itself from the corporate elite who want to keep the
working class down.

With the growing rise of MAGA fascism in this country, voters don’t want
feckless politicians who run further to the right and cozy up to corporate
interests like Republicans — they are looking to the left for a true
opposition party.

Though our focus is federal races, Zohran embodies the future we’ve been
fighting for since our founding in 2018, and we’re keeping it up by
recruiting and supporting working-class progressive candidates to
challenge do-nothing Democratic incumbents who refuse to change.

We’re already supporting State Rep. Donavan McKinney in his primary
challenge against out-of-touch, multi-millionaire incumbent Rep. Shri
Thanedar. To elect him and other progressive, working-class candidates to
Congress, it’s going to take a groundswell of grassroots support, just
like we saw in Zohran’s race.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250625?refcode=em20250625-36789&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36789_1203867_nRQ7BU&akid=36789%2E1203867%2EnRQ7BU ]Invest in our upcoming 2026 congressional primary fights: pitch in
$5 or whatever you can afford today.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250625?refcode=em20250625-36789&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36789_1203867_nRQ7BU&akid=36789%2E1203867%2EnRQ7BU ]Contribute $5

This is a promising sign of hope, and a warning to every career politician
that thinks they can survive a primary from the left.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Dear Peter,
---
Part 2 of our _Worship From The White House_ podcast series is out now! I’m once again joined by Antonio and Allison Marin—an incredibly gifted husband-and-wife worship team who have joined me at revivals all across the country. They were also with me as we worshiped in the White House earlier this year! We sat down in the heart of Washington, D.C. at our headquarters, Camp Elah, to talk about the title of this episode: _The Psalmist’s Anointing._ You won’t want to miss this insightful and encouraging conversation! _**WATCH THE CONVERSATION ⬇︎⬇︎⬇︎**_

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=dcac8242330e4c15a55d3b915d5debd3&_m=76e37ec63b064b76bda7b06c2de959c8&_e=M8EROlGvA8o1nVTBmgyLA1Ed6px7GFwipnrDMigK5rsqSL8aBik-ZP3V8qTb5hd92n-8LfDeA5ZZWq3w1gSSQ2EYFGtXoU5_i3Qh93nn6rASxwRyqEHiCbNNZWUwGMy5c3vwkwEOmQJZZMQme8iottUkXbX6qYN1jZuJeKqKpOHMzYHE06ZB9pAseJtSR2fpGWi7AJbhce7FC6wX4zkoyp-PNZBz8tS_wjW9wQg-u7M1jlPtl7kNfy7pJrwFc4ID6V5aiqxmEfilNCHbm5ifoqtR_k8Tb48mncqpMCcKI-HpDQ9SfjXEKZxUrWzrVcS7Bnpr4eNnC9ZswJuuijxqhtJ3HFFda9yNzXSLjeK1NLMBTW_bIkJF6mtg-w68XEt5CtzLw1yVRgmV65En6vxMyJS8vcr8uW8aYY6ntJstYjBVrOvcuWgcenWE9V30lwvP)

subject: We're not backing down, Peter

body:
Peter,

When Donald Trump issues unlawful executive orders, it’s up to state attorneys general to fight back—and that’s exactly what we’re doing.

I’m proud to be part of a coalition of AGs who are working around the clock to stop Trump’s extreme and dangerous agenda. As I told Congress on Monday: we’re not tired, and we can do this longer than the Trump administration can do this.

We’re not backing down. Not now, not ever. And I’m asking you to stand with us.

ADD YOUR NAME: https://secure.ngpvan.com/04biHgT760SSKkXWJr5w9g2

These aren’t symbolic fights. We’ve sued Trump and delivered real results:

- We blocked Trump’s plan to dismantle the Department of Education.
- We restored over $11 billion in funding for public health.
- We stopped the Trump administration’s reckless federal funding freeze.

But every victory brings more resistance from Trump and his MAGA allies, who want to rewrite the rules and grab more power for themselves.

We’ll keep holding Trump accountable in court, but we need your support.

Peter, will you stand with me and show Trump and his cronies that no one is above the law?

ADD YOUR NAME: https://secure.ngpvan.com/04biHgT760SSKkXWJr5w9g2

Thank you,

Keith

Attorney General Keith Ellison is the People’s Lawyer, fighting to help people afford their lives and live with safety, dignity, and respect.

name: Chris MacKenzie
subject: INVITE: Thursday AI Law Moratorium Virtual Press Conference
body:
Tomorrow at 1 PM ET, we’re hosting a virtual press conference featuring state legislators speaking out in opposition.

| | | | | |
---
|
---
[|
---](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=a9cd5bc77e&e=a07d75591f)
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Team,
We’re down to the wire as Congress considers passing a 10-year moratorium on state AI legislation. Tomorrow at 1 PM ET, we’re hosting a virtual press conference featuring state legislators speaking out in opposition.
---
| [Virtual Press Conference Registration Here](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=febabd886d&e=a07d75591f)
---
| Join ARI Senior Advisor Satya Thallam as he moderates a conversation with state lawmakers, including South Carolina’s Rep. Brandon Guffy, Utah’s Sen. Heidi Balderree, Utah’s Rep. Doug Fiefia, and Montana’s Sen. Barry Usher.
---
[|
---](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=a734531998&e=a07d75591f)
| Buried deep in the Big Beautiful Bill is a disastrous provision that would ban states and local governments from regulating AI for 10 whole years. As state lawmakers respond to deepfakes, job losses, and data exploitation, we can’t let Congress trample states’ rights to implement AI policies.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | ARI jumped into the fight. We’ve helped gather over [25,000 petitions](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=53f4545dd4&e=a07d75591f) against the moratorium and have organized a coalition of 260 state lawmakers who have announced their opposition to the ban.
And now, we’re in the final stretch.
---
| With the provision likely to be voted on this week, we’re calling a virtual press conference with state lawmakers who are opposed to the moratorium to discuss its impact on existing state laws, future AI legislation as systems advance, and the moratorium’s ties to broadband funding.
---
| [Virtual Press Conference Registration Here](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=e8fb6a276a&e=a07d75591f)
---
| Join our AI law moratorium press conference at 1 PM on Thursday, June 26th, to learn more about the ban and how we can push back against it. This event is open to the press and public.

Onward,
Chris MacKenzieVP of CommunicationsAmericans for Responsible Innovation

The race was a microcosm of the internal fight within the Democratic Party over what lesson we take from our loss in 2024 and what strategy we adopt to win against Trump in 2026 and 2028. On one side was Andrew Cuomo - the embodiment of the establishment status quo and the notion that doing more of the same will be enough. And on the other was Zohran Mamdani - the anti-establishment candidate running on a bold progressive and aggressively anti-Trump platform. Whereas, Zohran was funded solely by grassroots donors, Cuomo received hundreds of thousands from the same billionaires who fund Trump. Trump backers gave money to Cuomo because they knew he would pay lip service to opposing Trump but in practice would serve their interests and take no substantive action against the president. Voters can see through this and when we run Cuomos, _we lose_. But if we run Zohrans - candidates who can offer a competing vision to the one offered by MAGA, **we win. ** **No Dem Left Behind was proud to have supported the effort to elect Zohran, in the run up to the 2026 midterms we 'll be working to ensure that our party has more Zohrans and less Cuomos. ** [**Can we count on you to support our critical work with a donation of whatever you can spare?**](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvUWHo9tkdcudztgboR-91DP2CvKJ5CAM_kUcEu2D83GkkcafwCnUZhwOJxdlnreNeSpqx-b3eO5Uiydf2fpOWn-ZzUzKl7rPhhUmSzwnz-YjnjTWo1q66SMUlncMhVtaniLmlCGXrRBtaQqiAiCs_EfyHwBvWXphnhBOZW1X7CNqeZoJ11I111GaYl3e4VHj8XWBapZk6E1fLQSTv10aWMk7v-3EACU-cc-gRVzhVNG9ccvW5oUIUSa_0tQKOljZ6fl8a8ghLfrw5iRK8zFeN7sGVshEskeWQGEPLTb4ZHi17suPCJD7tI507dgYb85I5uYNLlR0_YPN6BZ7lTRd_AbcYwTkLfM1qmJ6cwlGEEkA/4hn/LZyVRXIdRzaS5LvpkBpQ0g/h2/h001.laVi9ZusJdR2VMdzNYit1Pj3s3sMJbtuigWvi_HKsyE)

clean_body: | | Friend, Last night, Zohran Mamdani won the democratic primary for the New York City mayoral race, a political earthquake with reverberations that will be felt throughout the rest of this midterm and beyond. The Zolcano has erupted. | The race was a microcosm of the internal fight within the Democratic Party over what lesson we take from our loss in 2024 and what strategy we adopt to win against Trump in 2026 and 2028. On one side was Andrew Cuomo - the embodiment of the establishment status quo and the notion that doing more of the same will be enough. And on the other was Zohran Mamdani - the anti-establishment candidate running on a bold progressive and aggressively anti-Trump platform. Whereas, Zohran was funded solely by grassroots donors, Cuomo received hundreds of thousands from the same billionaires who fund Trump. Trump backers gave money to Cuomo because they knew he would pay lip service to opposing Trump but in practice would serve their interests and take no substantive action against the president. Voters can see through this and when we run Cuomos, we lose. But if we run Zohrans - candidates who can offer a competing vision to the one offered by MAGA, we win. No Dem Left Behind was proud to have supported the effort to elect Zohran, in the run up to the 2026 midterms we 'll be working to ensure that our party has more Zohrans and less Cuomos. This is how we start winning again. Team No Dem Left Behind | | Mail checks to: No Dem Left Behind P.O. body:
Trump made inroads in New Jersey, we must fight back

| |
---
Team, We know this sentence might be hard to believe, but it's true: _**New Jersey is a battleground state.**_
* Phil Murphy was re-elected Governor with only 51 percent of the vote in 2021.
* Donald Trump improved his margin by roughly 10 points in the state in 2024 compared to 2020.
* Trump even won right here in NJ-09, making Nellie one of thirteen Democratic members of Congress to win in a Trump district.

There's nothing to sugarcoat, team. ---
| **Dear Friend,** This week, I have the honor of speaking at the [**Faith and Freedom Coalition’s Road to Majority Conference**](https://markharrisforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=82117f51bb8b79bb18d514427&id=616a9b4568&e=4024c5123e) — an opportunity that brings me back to where this journey began.

For over 30 years, I served as a pastor, walking alongside families in their moments of joy, sorrow, and hope. From counseling young couples to comforting those facing loss, I’ve seen the strength of our communities and the challenges we face together. As a father and grandfather, **I’ve carried those lessons into my work as your Representative, fighting for the values that make our nation strong—faith, family, and freedom.**

Today, I’m reaching out with a personal request. **_Our country is at a crossroads_.** Economic pressures are straining families, our borders are under siege, and the values we hold dear are under attack. **In Congress, I’m working tirelessly to secure our future by advocating for policies that strengthen our economy, protect our communities, and preserve the principles that have guided me through decades of ministry.**

But I can’t do this alone. The radical agenda in Washington is well-funded and relentless, and I need your support to keep fighting for you. Your contribution of **$25, $50, or $100** will fuel our campaign to stand up for hardworking families, secure our borders, and defend the freedoms that define us.

My journey from the pulpit to Congress has been driven by a calling to serve. As a pastor, I listened to the struggles of everyday Americans. As your Representative, I’m fighting to ensure those voices are heard. **Together, we can protect the heart of our nation for our children and grandchildren.**

Will you stand with me today? Your support will make a difference in this critical moment.

Mark Harris

Wednesday, June 25, 2025 | Peter -- In last week's _**Forward Thinking**_ , we asked you where you think the government should invest in our education system. We also expanded our surveys across several social media platforms, both to increase access but to see if results would differ between them. What did you say, and how much alignment was there? On X: On Facebook: On Threads (note the small response rate): On LinkedIn: Looking at the results, two things stick out to us. First, the top answer across the board was increasing teacher pay. Teachers are among the lowest paid workers with commensurate education levels, and many school systems are so under-resourced that teachers have to spend their own money to buy classroom supplies. The majority of you across all platforms called for properly resourcing our school systems. The second thing we noticed is that there were general trends across all platforms. Better teacher pay resoundingly beat out the other options, but the other options all had significant support and were pretty clustered together. We'll likely remove teacher pay from the equation in a follow up question and focus on these other options to see where you would focus once teachers are properly compensated. Education reform is complex, and so there were a (record-breaking) number of comments left to dive into: **Increasing Equity In Education**
* By far the largest category of responses we received involved creating a more equitable school system that tailors education to the needs of each pupil, instead of to the average student.
* This would include increased special education resourcing as well as more options for vocational programs and increased support for gifted and talented students.

**Curriculum Modernization**
* Calls for modernizing our standard curriculum were constant refrains in the comment sections this week. The foundation of our curriculum was set before the internet and modern workforce practices changed the skills needed for employment. Our curriculum should change to match.

**Affordable and Accessible Higher Education**
* The cost of university and the debt burden most students have to undertake to earn a degree is gutting our burgeoning middle class. You all want a solution to this problem, whether it's debt relief or more access to public universities for lower costs.

clean_body: It was a big week at Forward - here's what you missed. | | Wednesday, June 25, 2025 | Peter -- In last week's Forward Thinking , we asked you where you think the government should invest in our education system. We also expanded our surveys across several social media platforms, both to increase access but to see if results would differ between them. What did you say, and how much alignment was there? On X: On Facebook: On Threads (note the small response rate): On LinkedIn: Looking at the results, two things stick out to us. First, the top answer across the board was increasing teacher pay. Teachers are among the lowest paid workers with commensurate education levels, and many school systems are so under-resourced that teachers have to spend their own money to buy classroom supplies. The majority of you across all platforms called for properly resourcing our school systems. The second thing we noticed is that there were general trends across all platforms. Better teacher pay resoundingly beat out the other options, but the other options all had significant support and were pretty clustered together. We'll likely remove teacher pay from the equation in a follow up question and focus on these other options to see where you would focus once teachers are properly compensated. Education reform is complex, and so there were a (record-breaking) number of comments left to dive into: Increasing Equity In Education By far the largest category of responses we received involved creating a more equitable school system that tailors education to the needs of each pupil, instead of to the average student. This would include increased special education resourcing as well as more options for vocational programs and increased support for gifted and talented students. Curriculum Modernization Calls for modernizing our standard curriculum were constant refrains in the comment sections this week. The foundation of our curriculum was set before the internet and modern workforce practices changed the skills needed for employment. Our curriculum should change to match. Affordable and Accessible Higher Education The cost of university and the debt burden most students have to undertake to earn a degree is gutting our burgeoning middle class.
